title: DCO engine: scale, pause or hold
description: An n8n workflow that joins ad spend to affiliate revenue, tests each creative variant for significance, and only then scales, pauses or holds its budget. Built by Dyaksa.
intro: A scheduled n8n workflow that joins ad spend to affiliate revenue, tests every creative variant for statistical significance, and only then scales, pauses or holds its budget. Scroll to follow one variant through all 19 nodes.

stations.title: Spend, budgets and revenue, pulled together.
stations.body: Every 6 hours, three API calls start from one trigger: ad spend, ad-set budgets and affiliate revenue. They page through results and retry four times, 10 seconds apart, because a partial pull would quietly understate spend. A Merge waits for all three.

stations.title: Ad clicks are joined to the money they made.
stations.body: Ad platforms can't see affiliate revenue. A Code node joins spend to revenue on the sub-ID carried through the click, rolls ads up per creative variant, and works out CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS and EPC.
stations.code:
const rev = revenueBySub[String(r.ad_id)] || { conversions: 0, revenue: 0 };
const roas = v.spend ? v.revenue / v.spend : 0;

stations.title: Too little data means no decision.
stations.body: A variant needs enough impressions and at least 100 clicks before anything changes. Below that it is logged as insufficient_data and left alone. Noise is not a signal.
check: Enough Data To Decide? · false → Log Still Learning

stations.title: A big lift still has to be real.
stations.body: All variants go to a Python script once per cycle: a two-proportion z-test with a Bonferroni correction for the number of variants. In the repo's fixture, a +40% lift at p = 0.0194 is held, because the corrected threshold is 0.0167.
check: Run Significance Test · ab_significance.py · execute once

stations.title: Scale, pause or hold, with guard rails.
stations.body: A Switch routes each variant. Scaling steps the budget by a capped multiplier and becomes a hold if the current budget can't be read, because 0 × 1.2 would set it to zero. A variant under 70% of target ROAS is paused on economics alone.

stations.title: A paused ad asks for its own replacement.
stations.body: The losing ad is paused, and a new brief with the reason is appended to the sheet the creative factory reads at 06:00. Every decision, whichever branch it took, lands in the DCO Decision Log.
check: Pause Losing Ad → Request Replacement Creative → Log Decision

stations.title: One buying report per cycle.
stations.body: The Slack report hangs off Parse Test Result and runs once. Hung off Log Decision, it would post once per branch. The end-to-end test caught exactly that.
check: Parse Test Result → Post Buying Report · execute once

stations.title: A failed cycle reaches a person, not a budget.
stations.body: Any failed execution goes to an Error Trigger, which posts the failing node, the error and the execution link to #eng-alerts.

stations.title: 19 nodes, two places it refuses to act.
stations.body: The volume floor and the significance test are where it says no. Scaling too slowly costs a few hours of upside. Scaling a false winner costs real money. The riskiest logic is a script you can run against a fixture from a terminal.

edgeCases: 4 attempts, 10 s apart, on the ingestion calls
Scale decision but current budget unknown
Downgraded to hold with the reason logged
Large lift that isn't significant after correction
ROAS floor in the decision bands
Paused and a replacement brief queued
Engineering alerted with the failed execution
notBuilt: OAuth2 platform credentials (Meta, Google Ads) instead of static tokens
Retry-After-aware pagination that honours the server's back-off header
Bayesian decisions with Beta-Binomial posteriors for the 6-hour cycle
Bandit allocation and creative-fatigue detection from CTR decay
Holdout groups, so the engine's contribution is measured rather than assumed
